description: This file defines an intrusive doubly-linked list template class 'SpdyIntrusiveList' and its associated link class 'SpdyIntrusiveLink' used for embedding list pointers within elements for efficient insertion and removal operations. It includes detailed comments on usage, limitations, and implementation details.

classes.name: spdy::SpdyIntrusiveLink
classes.description: A base class for elements to be stored in an intrusive list, providing link pointers and casting methods.

classes.name: spdy::SpdyIntrusiveList
classes.description: A template class implementing a doubly-linked intrusive list with embedded link pointers, supporting insertion, deletion, splicing, and iteration.

methods.name: begin()
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end()
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the element past the last.

methods.name: push_front(T* obj)
methods.description: Inserts an element at the front of the list.

methods.name: push_back(T* obj)
methods.description: Inserts an element at the end of the list.

methods.name: erase(T* obj)
methods.description: Removes an element from the list given a pointer to it.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list (O(N)).

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Resets the list to empty state.
